profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Raytheon Technologies
profile.summary:
Active Top Secret DOD Security Clearance TS/SCI Polygraph.

Over 20 years of Information Technology experience in system engineering, business architecture, applications architecture, software development, system administration, and database administration.  Technical Manager experienced in leading teams to architect, develop, and deploy custom software applications.  Proven expertise in systems integration of COTS products using Oracle and SQL Server databases.  Experienced in database design, backup, recovery, performance tuning, and database security.  Knowledge of systems development life cycle, web services, client/server architecture, systems integration, internet applications, telephony, telecommunications, and operational support systems.

CERTIFICATIONS:
AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Developer Associate, CompTia Security+ Certified, Oracle DBA 9i Associate, ITIL v3 Certified
LANGUAGES:
Java, Visual Basic, Perl, Python, Unix shell, SQL, PL/SQL, JDBC
PLATFORMS:
Operating Systems:  Unix (Solaris, Linux, HP-UX, SCO), Windows
Databases:  Oracle, SQL Server 2000/2005, Informix, MySQL, MongoDB
Applications:  WebLogic, Netcracker, Amdocs Cramer, Visionael, Remedy, Nightfire, MapR
Tools:  Eclipse, NetBeans, Maven, SVN, XMLSpy, SoapUI, Toad, Oracle Developer
EDUCATION:    
Bachelor of Science, Management Information Systems & Decision Sciences.
George Mason University, Fairfax, Virginia. 1999.
Bachelor of Science, Business Finance.
Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University, Blacksburg, Virginia. 1996.
PROFESSIONAL TRAINING:
Oracle 10g Database Administration, Solaris 10 Administration, SQL Server 2005, Oracle 9i DBA Performance Tuning, Telecommunications & Operational Support Systems, C++, Java for Programmers, Effective Perl Programming, COBOL, Network Architecture, TCP/IP, Unix I & II, NightFire, Visionael NRM, Remedy, ActiveWorks middleware, Netcracker, Liferay Portal, Security+, ITIL Foundation for IT Service Management.
